title: Time Value of Money (TVM) - computing the number of periods (for the CFA Level 1 exam)
description:
Time Value of Money - computing the number of periods explores the steps needed to compute N (the number of periods) using the TVM worksheet on the Texas Instruments BA II Plus calculator.

For a comprehensive directory of all videos featured on this channel, please visit the channel companion website: www.letmeexplain.eu
